scope: Local BasePet passive and six automatic buffs; source methods/selected fragments, 720 controlled native cases. Full game, visual callbacks and unrelated hero buffs excluded.

contracts.PB-01: One selected live session, counters belong to BasePet instance; default 300, replacement resets, resting roster does not tick.
contracts.PB-02: Passive postincrement >= frameClips: period fps+1; heal HP then MP using prior upPassive values, refresh after AI.
contracts.PB-03: upPassive int(level/5): HP 3x quotient, MP quotient; HP cure skips dead, MP cure does not.
contracts.PB-04: Stun skips AI and automatic counters, not preceding passive; host pause skips steps entirely.
contracts.PB-05: Six ordered independent checks sxkb/fsnl/smjc/mfjc/gjjc/fyjc; learned and >=20 MP; sequential debit permits multiple in one step.
contracts.PB-06: sxkb reset4320, others5400 original calls, not fps-normalized seconds; uint duration before multiplication by fps.
contracts.PB-07: sxkb/fsnl on pet; four stat buffs on source hero; source harm first gets final1.05, old value survives same-name refresh.
contracts.PB-08: Hero effect step -> hero integer property add/remove -> pet step; zero-left property removal precedes next effect nulling.
contracts.PB-09: Pet destroy clears pet effect and owner link but does not remove already enrolled hero effects; replacing resets pet timers.
contracts.PB-10: Dragon private type1 skips checkBuffSkill; all46 extracted class override inventory retained, no generic all-roster or all-private-entity tick.

sourceFragments.BaseAddEffect.step: first/startTime and expiration/null removal/count++ for six names; visual callbacks omitted
sourceFragments.BaseAddEffect.remove: original indexOf/null assignment; visual hide callbacks omitted
sourceFragments.BaseRoleProperies.step: four PET stat-buff checks only; own regen/input/other buffs omitted
sourceFragments.BaseRoleProperies.addBuff/removeBuff: four PET cases plus original guards/storage; other buffs omitted
sourceFragments.BasePet.destroy: verbatim caller; BBDC/Tween/network/protection/child visualization are sinks
sourceFragments.Info: controlled integer stat storage and skill lookup; original upPassive/harm/cost executed; no full PetInfo constructor

visual.requiredFollowup: independent display/timeline truth and production projection before visual closure

modern.timerOwner: existing PetCombatEntitySession original host tick; no second clock
